legal.title: Publisher
paragraphs: Legal entity, registration, tax and hosting details remain to be confirmed.

legal.title: Website use
paragraphs: The website presents engineering and project advisory services. Information is general and does not constitute a binding technical proposal.
No professional authorisation or legal capacity should be inferred beyond verified contractual scope.

legal.title: Data collected
paragraphs: The enquiry form may collect name, company, business email, service interest and a project-context message.
Do not submit confidential documents, personal identification numbers or sensitive technical data.

legal.title: Purpose and retention
paragraphs: Data is intended only to review and respond to project enquiries.
Retention periods, controller identity, processors and exercise-of-rights procedures must be confirmed before launch.

legal.title: Necessary technology
paragraphs: The website may use strictly necessary platform and security mechanisms required to serve pages and process forms.

legal.title: Future analytics
paragraphs: Analytics or advertising technologies will be introduced only with an approved consent mechanism and updated privacy information.
